name: Missing Entanglement Event Handler
hint: An entanglement operation creates the entangled state and default visual representation even without a handler, but no custom behavior runs for the entanglement-start event.
instruction: Add a non-empty [when entanglement started] handler to one participating actor to define custom behavior for the entangled state.
